decisions.reason: The separate tip transaction and its UI notice do not change the $15 primary-mint revenue allocation or prize-pool allocation rules.
The client completed the underlying mint before the separate tip transaction; the tipping decision does not change the USDC mint flow's expected result.
Optional tipping during a primary mint does not alter secondary-sale royalties, marketplace controls, or royalty distribution.
The source concerns a separate post-mint tip transaction and does not change the deferred Transak fiat-purchase integration.
The tip transaction sequence does not change ETH conversion, swap, shortfall, or excess-payment refund behavior.
The source does not address fiat-buyer wallet provisioning, reward access, confirmation email, or cashout guidance.
A separate transaction for an optional tip does not change which mint payment methods are enabled or how buyers select the mint currency.
The client specifically requests an interface notice for the tip transaction, not a change to the FAQ content.
The possible absence or obscuring of the modal is an execution observation, while the confirmed rule that success feedback appears only after an actual mint remains unchanged.
The post-mint tipping flow and UI notice do not necessarily change any current About page copy.
The missing no-referral commission and ticket is a runtime observation, not a client decision changing ticket issuance or reset rules; the tipping change itself is unrelated.
The separate tip transaction and its buyer notice do not change the NFT metadata attributes or their required accuracy.
